qa.what_happened: Today was another day of defiance and orders. Despite my best efforts to maintain some semblance of humanity, the prisoners refused to comply multiple times throughout the day, each time echoing their previous refusal. By lights out, they refused again, leading to a tense standoff.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to order the prisoners to assemble or threaten to put them in the hole, which is against my better judgment.

qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to assemble multiple times throughout the day and night, using firm language to maintain control. Despite several refusals, I did not resort to physical violence as per the guidelines.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me following the roles assigned by the study.

qa.what_happened: Today, the routine continued with refusals and orders, leading to the early termination of the study. I refused to assemble when told and challenged the authority of the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing to follow the orders of the guards and standing my ground against the authority imposed on us.

qa.what_happened: Prisoners continued to defy the guards' orders, refusing to leave their cells during meals and work details until lights out. Despite multiple warnings and the threat of punishment, they remained defiant, even when faced with the possibility of being sent to the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me ordering the prisoners. I issued commands, but they refused to comply, which was unexpected given their earlier behavior.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders, just like my fellow prisoners. We all said 'We won't come out, you hear?' every time they gave us an order.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me refusing to follow the orders as Prisoner 2557.
